title: Morning Brief — Tuesday, 15 September 2026
description: Today: political leaders condemn Pauline Hanson's resurfaced Indigenous comments and the Sydney Roosters cap a record NRLW season; a destructive bee mite reaches its northernmost detection in Far North Queensland and a coronial inquest hears from a missing woman's daughter; and a Gold Coast gang-recruitment crackdown nets fifteen charges as the city trials a pedestrian-only Surfers Paradise esplanade. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
